scope: Real React/compiler/DOM/native observers and scroll with authored width/container/card CSS, observer instrumentation and Card port. First phase actual main-row adapter; second explicitly authored generic-Carousel selection/snap caller (main Rows does not pass those props). No original Card/media/navigation/provider/CSS/application or visual parity.

observations.name: actual main Rows delegates native per-card scroll-root admission and measures first wrapper width plus gap
callback ref updates without recreating near-end observer; native scroll fires latest callback and admission remains one-way
actual child-list mutation remeasures; changed child count replaces near-end observer
eager bypass mounts every synthetic Card while viewport near-end mode owns its actual root/margin
explicitly authored generic Carousel caller supplies selectedIndex/snap, unlike main Rows
actual selected-index effect drives native smooth scroll and natural scrollend snap
native ResizeObserver samples current callback-time offset and instant-snaps its rounded width multiple; pre-resize offset is not assumed
changed gap replaces measurement effects; unmount disconnects all owned observers and scrollend/subscription listeners
